strings.name: Deepika Padukone
strings.summary: Raised in Bengaluru, Padukone moved from badminton and modeling into Kannada, Hindi and English films. She combines commercial cinema with character work and production. In 2015 she discussed depression publicly and founded LiveLoveLaugh to reduce stigma and improve access to care. India appointed her mental-health ambassador in 2025.
